question: The weather group RERA in a TAF means:
options: rain in retreat
recent rain
returning rain
retreating rain

question: TEMPO in a TAF means:
options: a temporary variation to the main forecast that will last for less than one hour, or, if recurring, for less than half the period indicated
a temporary variation to the main forecast, lasting less than an hour
the development of unpredictable conditions that may be a hazard to aviation
a variation to the baseline conditions laid down in the main forecast that will continue to prevail until the end of the main forecast

question: The weather group SHSNRA in a TAF means:
options: slight showers of snow and rain
moderate showers of snow and rain
heavy showers of snow and rain
showers of snow and rain

question: A TAF time group 0202/0220 means that the TAF:

was observed at 0220 UTC
was issued at 0220 UTC
is a long-range forecast for the 18-hour period from the 2nd at 0200 UTC to the 2nd at 2000 UTC

becoming from 1820 UTC, 3-4 oktas of cloud at 3000 ft AGL
